label: Metaconceptual Art origin provenance
description: Machine-readable origin chronology for Metaconceptual Art. This file distinguishes the studio formation, movement origin, early artwork evidence, and later public linked-data publication so the project is not framed as a retrospective 2026 invention.

events.label: Sun & Rain Works established
events.description: Sun & Rain Works was established as the art business and studio context for the later Metaconceptual Art movement.

events.label: Metaconceptual Art movement created
events.description: Metaconceptual Art is asserted by Sun & Rain Works as a movement created in 2007, before the 2026 linked-data publication layer.

events.label: The auction as artwork (concept)
events.description: Not a work but the concept the studio's two works around the 2009 engagement share: that its consignment of an Ansel Adams photograph, 'San Francisco from Twin Peaks' (lot 16), to the Sotheby's Photographs sale N08533 can be treated, after the logic of the readymade, as the material of art. Earlier versions of this profile recorded 'The Auction as Artwork' as a titled work; the phrase was introduced by this collection's data model on 2026-07-10 and no dated document uses it. The concept is asserted by the studio, its earliest dated statement is 2013, it is not a publicly witnessed live-creation event, and the catalogue does not name Sun & Rain Works.

events.label: www.wtfisart.com (website) — the work of the 2009 origin claim
events.description: The work this profile's 2009 origin claim names: a website built and owned by Sun & Rain Works in connection with its consignment of lot 16 to Sotheby's Photographs sale N08533, realising the studio's concept of the auction as artwork. The registrar's receipt of 2009-03-16, billed to Sun and Rain Works, dates the name fourteen days before the sale. The studio states that the W of the name stands for 'What'. WTF is Ansel Adams is the related work. It is not recorded as having been authored live in the auction room.

events.label: WTF is Ansel Adams (conceptual designation)
events.description: A conceptual work that Sun & Rain Works designates around its consignment of the Ansel Adams photograph (lot 16) to Sotheby's Photographs, 2009, related to www.wtfisart.com and realising the same concept. The studio states that the W of the title stands for 'Who'. The title is not independently dated. It is an assertion by the artist, made explicit over time, and is not recorded as a publicly witnessed performance.

events.label: Public linked-data publication
events.description: The 2026 web publication makes the movement, profile, selected works, and records machine-readable as Linked Art, IIIF, JSON-LD, SHACL, VoID, and DCAT.

comparisonPolicy.label: Comparison and priority policy
comparisonPolicy.description: Earlier studio evidence may establish priority for a documented Metaconceptual Art structure without asserting direct influence on later artists or events unless evidence of contact, access, or derivation is separately published.
comparisonPolicy.recommendedClaim: Documented prior evidence for a related metaconceptual structure.
comparisonPolicy.avoidClaim: Direct influence, copying, or misattribution without separate evidence.
